articles.title: Zelensky announces government reshuffle, changes in law enforcement leadership
articles.summary: President Zelensky announced an upcoming reshuffle of Ukraine's Cabinet of Ministers and changes in law enforcement leadership as part of a new political strategy.

articles.title: Zelensky meets with Senator Graham
articles.summary: President Zelensky met with U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham in Kyiv to discuss strengthening sanctions against Russia and Ukraine's urgent air defense needs.

articles.title: Zelensky to attend Coalition of the Willing meeting in Paris
articles.summary: President Zelensky will take part in a meeting of the Coalition of the Willing in Paris on July 13, aimed at strengthening support for Ukraine and increasing pressure on Russia.

articles.title: Zelensky: Ukraine's peace proposals have support even within Putin's inner circle
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated in an evening address that Ukraine's peace proposals have support from international partners and even from within Putin's inner circle.

articles.title: Zelensky calls Russia's fuel imports 'historical joke'
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine has significantly disrupted Russia's fuel supply, forcing the traditionally energy-exporting nation to import fuel.
